| ENERGY COMBAT
XX Energy attack costing 3 stages.
This attack can only be stopped by an Energy Combat
card. Your opponent skips their next action this combat.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: If your opponent has not performed an action
this combat, draw a card.
(Banish after use.)
